coverage_notes:
Exhaustive sweep across cross-cutting market signals for MetroGraph's category: AI-native convergence, agentic workflows 2026, consolidation patterns, visualization-only market gaps, and graph adoption friction.

ANGLE 1 — Market Sizing & CAGR (Data Visualization): Covered via Mordor, SkyQuest, Technavio, Coherent, IMARC, Markets&Markets, MarketResearchFuture (9-14% CAGRs, $9.7B-$30B ranges 2024-2032). ANGLE 2 — Graph Database Expansion: Market scouts Neo4j (200M ARR by 2025, Infinigraph Sept 2025), graph CAGR 24-25% (vs. 10% visualization), 80% adoption forecast by 2030 per Gartner. ANGLE 3 — Low-Code/No-Code Platform Growth: Gartner 14-26% CAGR ($58-94B forecasts 2027-2028), citizen developer adoption barriers (governance, vendor lock-in, scalability). ANGLE 4 — Agentic AI Market Consolidation: Gartner 40% enterprise agents by EOY 2026 (vs. <5% 2025), only 11% in production despite 79% adoption claim (deployment gap), top 10 deals capture 73-78% capital, frontier lab consolidation (OpenAI $122B vs. Anthropic considering IPO). ANGLE 5 — RAG/LLM Infrastructure: Vector database market $2.3-4.3B by 2026-2028 (38-42% CAGR), naive RAG fails 40% retrieval rate, hybrid search + agentic RAG dominant, enterprise use for fraud/personalization. ANGLE 6 — Database Visualization Tool Landscape: Airtable vs. Baserow vs. Retool comparison space active; Gartner MQ shows Google, Qlik, ThoughtSpot as BI leaders; Power BI 20-30% market share North America; Tableau 15-20%. ANGLE 7 — HCI & Visual Complexity Friction: Enterprise dashboard overloads (buried settings, onboarding friction), ~30-70% error reduction with ergonomic design, cognitive load measurement emerging. ANGLE 8 — AI-Assisted Visualization Code Gen: 92% developer adoption of "vibe coding" by 2026, LLMs generating D3/Plotly code from NL, Recharts/ECharts outpacing D3 for 95% of projects. ANGLE 9 — Workflow Orchestration + Agents: Workflow market $26-40B (2026-2031 CAGR 7-9%), agentic orchestration (UiPath Maestro, multi-agent coordination) emerging pattern. ANGLE 10 — MongoDB NoSQL: 45% market share, 28% CAGR, native vector search, 55K+ companies adopted. ANGLE 11 — Semantic Web / Knowledge Graphs: $5B 2025 market, 20-27% CAGR to $20B by 2033, enterprise adoption accelerating with AI/ML. ANGLE 12 — Observability / Monitoring Dashboards: $2.9B 2025 growing 15-19% CAGR to $6.9-172B forecasts (wide variance), GenAI+LLM observability integration, cloud-native workload focus. ANGLE 13 — EDA Tools Market: $15B 2025 → $45B 2033 (15% CAGR), AI querying adoption rising but trust in AI-generated results remains low, self-service BI empowering business users. ANGLE 14 — Funding Landscape: CB Insights $469B venture funding 2025 (AI $226B = 48%), top 10 deals 78% of capital, Anthropic/OpenAI consolidating frontier model spend; a16z $15B mega-fund raised (Jan 2026), AI $202.3B of 2025 global VC. ANGLE 15 — Analyst Coverage: Gartner Magic Quadrant reports (BI/Analytics 2025, Data Governance 2026, Augmented Data Quality 2026), Forrester Wave (Data Management for Analytics Q2 2025, Master Data Management Q2 2025, Data Quality Q1 2026), McKinsey data-driven enterprise 2025 survey (88% AI adoption, 23x customer acquisition lift), Deloitte agentic AI strategy.

DEDUPLICATION RATIONALE: Consolidated ~60 raw search results into 45 unique sources by:
- Grouping Technavio/SkyQuest/CMI/IMARC reports by category (data viz, graph DB, low-code, observability, EDA all have multiple reports—kept highest-quality per firm)
- Merging Gartner Magic Quadrant variants (2025 BI/Analytics, 2026 Data Governance, 2026 Data Quality) — 3 sources
- Keeping Forrester Wave Q2 2025 (DMA platforms), Q2 2025 (Master Data Management), Q1 2026 (Data Quality) as separate; they address distinct categories
- Avoiding duplicate blog/listicle sources (e.g., multiple "best BI tools 2026" lists retained only 2-3 for practitioner perspective)
- Excluding vendor marketing materials (Tableau/Power BI/Qlik/Sisense product pages treated as references only, not separate sources)
- Keeping CHI/UIST academic references (graph visualization, info vis usability) for HCI angle; arXiv papers for AI+viz code gen

NOTABLE GAPS/DEFERRALS:
- Specific venture/funding records for data visualization startups (e.g., Sisense, Grafana Series rounds) — exists in CB Insights/Crunchbase proprietary databases, not freely searchable
- Detailed case studies of enterprise adoption (e.g., "how did Stripe/Uber migrate from Retool to custom graph viz?") — likely in paywalled analyst reports or internal documents
- Real-time market sentiment (e.g., Hacker News threads on "why graph UI is hard") — captured indirectly via practitioner blogs but not primary sources
- Academic HCI studies on graph layout algorithms vs. user comprehension post-2022 — CHI/UIST call for papers/proceedings largely paywalled; captured representative arXiv references
- Southeast Asia / emerging market visualization adoption — mostly covered under NA/EU focus in analyst reports; detailed regional data deferred

NAMED AUTHORITIES (T0/T1):
- Tier 0: Gartner (Magic Quadrants, Hype Cycles, Risk/Opportunity Index), Forrester (Wave reports), CB Insights, a16z, McKinsey, Deloitte
- Tier 1: Mordor Intelligence, SkyQuest, Technavio, Coherent Market Insights, IMARC, Markets&Markets, Precedence Research, Fortune Business Insights, Future Market Insights, ResearchNester
